sentences.text_target: Hello, my name is Tom.
sentences.text_native: Bonjour, je m'appelle Tom.

sentences.text_target: I live in a nice house.
sentences.text_native: J'habite dans une jolie maison.

sentences.text_target: My house is big.
sentences.text_native: Ma maison est grande.

sentences.text_target: I love my family.
sentences.text_native: J'aime ma famille.

sentences.text_target: My father and mother work hard.
sentences.text_native: Mon père et ma mère travaillent dur.

sentences.text_target: My father is a doctor.
sentences.text_native: Mon père est médecin.

sentences.text_target: My mother is a teacher.
sentences.text_native: Ma mère est professeur.

sentences.text_target: I have one brother and one sister.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn ˈbrʌðər ænd wʌn ˈsɪstər/
sentences.text_native: J'ai un frère et une sœur.

sentences.text_target: My brother is tall.
sentences.text_native: Mon frère est grand.

sentences.text_target: My sister is young.
sentences.text_native: Ma sœur est jeune.

sentences.text_target: Today is the weekend.
sentences.text_native: Aujourd'hui c'est le week-end.

sentences.text_target: Many people come to my house.
sentences.text_native: Beaucoup de gens viennent chez moi.

sentences.text_target: My grandfather and grandmother are here.
sentences.text_native: Mon grand-père et ma grand-mère sont là.

sentences.text_target: They are old and very kind.
sentences.text_native: Ils sont âgés et très gentils.

sentences.text_target: My uncle and aunt visit us too.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʌŋkəl ænd ænt ˈvɪzɪt ʌs tuː/
sentences.text_native: Mon oncle et ma tante nous rendent visite aussi.

sentences.text_target: My cousin is a nice boy.
sentences.text_native: Mon cousin est un gentils garçon.

sentences.text_target: We play together in the garden.
sentences.text_native: Nous jouons ensemble dans le jardin.

sentences.text_target: A little baby is sleeping inside.
sentences.text_native: Un petit bébé dort à l'intérieur.

sentences.text_target: The children laugh and run.
sentences.text_native: Les enfants rient et courent.

sentences.text_target: My mother cooks good food.
sentences.text_native: Ma mère cuisine de bons plats.

sentences.text_target: We eat at a big table.
sentences.text_native: Nous mangeons à une grande table.

sentences.text_target: We drink water and juice.
sentences.text_native: Nous buvons de l'eau et du jus.

sentences.text_target: The adults talk about their jobs.
sentences.text_native: Les adultes parlent de leur travail.

sentences.text_target: Everyone is very happy.
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde est très heureux.

sentences.text_target: My friend comes to see me later.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd kʌmz tu siː mi ˈleɪtər/
sentences.text_native: Mon ami vient me voir plus tard.

sentences.text_target: We are good friends.
sentences.text_native: Nous sommes de bons amis.

sentences.text_target: The sun shines on the big house.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə sʌn ʃaɪnz ɑn ðə bɪɡ haʊs/
sentences.text_native: Le soleil brille sur la grande maison.

sentences.text_target: Evening comes slowly now.
sentences.text_native: Le soir arrive lentement maintenant.

sentences.text_target: Family time is special.
sentences.text_native: Les moments en famille sont précieux.

sentences.text_target: I smile before I go to sleep.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ smaɪl bɪˈfɔr aɪ ɡoʊ tu sliːp/
sentences.text_native: Je souris avant de m'endormir.
